title: Fear Thy Roommate
description:
S01 E01 — Three's a Crowd
Two college students rent an apartment off campus together, but the two women couldn't be more different; squabbles escalate into an all-out war, and the presence of a boyfriend causes the feud to boil over into a deadly fight.

title: See No Evil
description:
S14 E02 — Cul-De-Sac
After the murder of Johnny Soekhies in Alabama, authorities turn to CCTV to hunt his killer; surveillance footage reveals a vehicle driving Johnny to the place of his eventual murder and captures a glimpse of a sinister figure lurking in the shadows.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S02 E01 — Unholy Ghost
Church parishioners call 911 when they find their priest stabbed to death, then police uncover an earlier 911 call made by the priest himself and track a missing cell phone to find his killer.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S02 E02 — Death Comes Knocking
In a distressing 911 call, a woman reports someone is breaking into her home, then the dispatcher hears a scream and a gunshot; investigators soon connect the case to a previous home invasion and race to solve the crimes.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S01 E03 — Down by the River
A terrified woman tries to give police clues in a harrowing call, then police find her body in the river, and they discover a stomach-churning truth about a killer who's been a predator for years.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S01 E02 — Seeing Red
Police in two cities receive a series of bizarre 911 calls from a serial killer confessing his crimes; the man becomes known as the Weepy Voiced Killer due to his strange, whining voice.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E07 — Murder Goes Live
After a woman tries to move on from her open relationship, she unwittingly gets into a war of words with her boyfriend's lover; as the online insults begin to escalate, he takes matters into his own hands with devastating consequences.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E06 — The Social Media Butterfly
When a beautiful young woman moves to New York City, a chance encounter leads to romance; however, her boyfriend finds her popularity on social media hard to swallow; tragic chain of events unfolds in which her unique tattoo plays a critical role.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E05 — The Deadly Hoax
When a computer wizard fails to make the grade as a professional video gamer, he becomes obsessed with achieving internet fame; what starts as an online prank spirals into a new and deadly crime called swatting that chills the nation.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E03 — The Devil's Pact
When a young mother plummets into depression, she turns to the internet for comfort, discovering a virtual world of fetishes, fantasies and dark intentions.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E08 — Webcam of Lies
A hopeful 12-year-old singer looks for fame online using her webcam, gathering many admirers; she soon falls for a boy who flatters her, but her dream turns into a nightmare after a shocking photo is shared online.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S06 E01 — Love at First Text
When a single mother finds her dream man online, she can't believe her luck; however, her quest to meet him soon turns into every mother's worst nightmare; as police scramble to avert tragedy, they discover an elaborate web of lies.

Marana Aerospace Solutions in Arizona is as hot and wild as the surrounding desert. When someone guns down one of the bosses, suspicion falls on the employees. Who hated the boss enough to kill him?

A girls' movie night leads to a not-so-happy ending for a group of college roommates; police investigate a murder that leads them halfway across the state in search of the killer.

Police question suspects in the inner circle of Jackie Galloway, a woman found strangled and bound with ritualistic knots; a chance encounter with a prowler leads them to the shocking discovery of a budding serial killer.

Hikers discover the severed head of Hervey Medellín in the Hollywood Hills; the suspects include former lovers, drug cartel hit men and a porn star in this tale of lust, greed and butchery.

description:

A terrified young escort calls 911 as she flees into the night and vanishes; her family pressures police to take up the search, and investigators uncover a strange cast of characters - plus 10 other bodies spread along a remote stretch of beach.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:

When police discover 10 bodies strewn along a remote beach, there are few answers and even fewer suspects; over a decade later, a new investigation uncovers old leads, and police finally think they've found their man.

description:

Comedian Jim Jefferies recounts his experiences with an intern who seems to have it all - luxury cars, exotic vacations and beautiful women; in May 2016, it all comes crashing down.

title: Death by Fame

A bodybuilding attorney lands her own reality series featuring her former fashion model boyfriend; a year later, investigators use her show to map how this legal diva went from the spotlight to becoming a stabbing victim.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:

When a grandmother vanishes, her grandson spins a twisted narrative about her demise and the disturbing location of her body inside a freezer; it doesn't take long for detectives to uncover the killer responsible, a parasitic psychopath.

title: Signs of a Psychopath

When a psychopathic husband kills his young wife and leaves her decapitated head in a bathtub, detectives question him about the crime; they realize they are confronting a malingering psychopath with control issues.

title: American Monster
